nrccMessages.Value: Trains running between Severn Tunnel Junction and Gloucester may be delayed. Latest information can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website.
Trains running in the Gloucester area may be delayed, cancelled, revised or diverted. Latest information can be found in the Disruptions area of the National Rail website.
